notes: The Setup website, reorganised: Set up (First-time setup · Screens · Family · Rewards · Advanced) · Help · Apps (Calendar · Notes · Lists · Widgets)
Screens & widgets: a “How this works” page at the top of the screens list; at most 6 screens
Family: who’s in the family (up to 10), their colours, and ⭐ Rewards – with an explainer
Rewards: everything on one page – tasks, morning to-dos, reminders, rules, changing a child’s points by hand (add, take away, set the balance, statement) and each child’s card
Advanced: Settings (home & places, data keys, system) · My data · My devices · About & diagnostics
Calendar and Help open inside the website; with more than one calendar page you can switch between them
